artifact.new-pavilion.emergencyTentArt.d:
{Emergency Tent}

The Emergency Tent is sturdier, more efficient than First Aid Tent and revives units (the effect doesn't last past the battle).
artifact.new-pavilion.fireRing.descripti:
{Ring of Scorching}

Worn on a finger, this item causes your Fire spells to inflict an additional 25% damage.
artifact.new-pavilion.fireRing.event: You take a rest under a large rock and notice something lying in the shade. It's a skeleton's arm wearing a strange ring on one of its charred fingers. The owner won't need it in the afterlife, so you put it in your pocket.
artifact.new-pavilion.fireRing.name: Ring of Scorching
artifact.new-pavilion.goldenScarab.descr:
{Golden Scarab}

Wearing this item increases your Morale by +1, and your income by +350 gold per day.
artifact.new-pavilion.goldenScarab.event: Strolling through the camp, you catch a glimpse of a shiny scarab scurrying away. When you catch it, it turns into a lifeless statue. Without thinking long, you hide it in your pocket.
artifact.new-pavilion.goldenScarab.name: Golden Scarab
artifact.new-pavilion.maskOfTheDesertKin:
{Mask of the Desert King}

Worn on the head, this item increases your Knowledge skill by +4, and increases the chance wandering creatures will offer to join the hero’s army.
In the ruins of an ancient city, you find a worn mask. As you put it on, vistas of past empires flash in your mind and you hear a voice 'Every kingdom falls. Maybe you will be the one'.
artifact.new-pavilion.scrollOfWisdom.des:
{Frog Of Sagacity}

The Frog of Sagacity allows you to cast spells with increased effectiveness, but reduces your Knowledge skill by 2.
artifact.new-pavilion.scrollOfWisdom.eve: When approaching a turn, you spot a nomad dying from thirst and exhaustion. In exchange for a generous draught from your flask, he gives you a wrapped bundle. You open it and take out a peculiar statue, but you notice the stranger had disappeared in the meantime.
artifact.new-pavilion.staffOfSand.descri:
{Staff Of Sand}

This right handed weapon increases your Power skill by +4, and helps you recover 2 extra spell points per day.
artifact.new-pavilion.staffOfSand.event: You spot an unnatural dune and decide to investigate it. You will be getting rid of sand from your armor for a long time, but the artifact that was hidden inside, is now in your possession.
artifact.new-pavilion.staffOfSand.name: Staff Of Sand
artifact.new-pavilion.sunShield.descript:
{Sun Shield}

This left handed item increases your Defense skill by +5, and Magic Resistance by 10%.
artifact.new-pavilion.sunShield.event: During a journey, you encounter Wadjets sleeping nearby, with a source of incredible radiance in their nest. You quietly sneak up and take the object. In safety, you marvel at the glistening beauty of the Sun Shield.
artifact.new-pavilion.sunShield.name: Sun Shield

creatures.new-pavilion.anubisWarrior.des:
{Divine Anubian}

{gold|Special Ability : Flying. Immune to earth spells. Health Regeneration. Vulnerable to Advanced Slayer. Can inflict God Scales after attack.}

Divine Anubians have 20% chance to inflict God Scales after attack. This state reduces enemy unit's attack down to 0 for two turns.

Divine Anubians are immune to all earth spells (positive and negative).

Drawing strength from primordial earth, Divine Anubians regenerate 60 points of health per round.

Enemy stacks enchanted by advanced Slayer, can do 200% damage to Divine Anubians.

Flying is a special ability of creatures, which allows them to bypass obstacles (e.g. walls) during combat. Having creatures with this special ability in a hero's army does not affect the movement of that hero on the adventure map in any way (meaning that flying creatures also cause a movement penalty on non-native terrain).
{Sand Runner}
Boosts Hero's movement by 150 points when starting turn on sandy terrains
creatures.new-pavilion.desertWarrior.bon:
{Desert Blessing}
Boosts Attack, Defense and Speed by 2 on sandy terrains

{Sand Runner}
Boosts Hero's movement by 150 points when starting turn on sandy terrains
creatures.new-pavilion.dunes-terrain.dun: Desert Dwarves descend from the clans of AvLee that settled upon the northern deserts of Bracada centuries ago. Guarding merchant roads and the caravans of Bracadas wizards, they became masters of the crossbow and survival beneath the unforgiving desert sun.
Carpet Whisperers are feline humanoids who wield magic woven into enchanted flying carpets. In battle, their living fabrics ensnare enemies, binding and crushing them with supernatural force.
creatures.new-pavilion.overseer.bonus.tr:
{Generate Gold}
Each Overseer produces 3 pieces of gold every day or 6 pieces if it's stationed in town
creatures.new-pavilion.preacher.descript:
{Preacher}

Pavilion's commander can cast Air Shield spell at basic level.
creatures.new-pavilion.scarab.bonus.incr:
{Luck}
Scarabs increase whole army luck by 1
creatures.new-pavilion.whipper.bonus.tri:

faction.new-pavilion.pavilion.name: Pavilion
hero.new-pavilion.0_amesh.biography: Amesh is the only human known to have gone toe to toe with a Sphinx during a riddling competition. His love for solving riddles and coming up with the new ones has gained him a notoriety and great respect among these esoteric creatures.
hero.new-pavilion.0_amesh.name: Amesh
hero.new-pavilion.0_amesh.specialty.desc: Increases the speed of Sphinxes or Sphinx Oracles by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.new-pavilion.0_amesh.specialty.name: Sphinxes
hero.new-pavilion.0_azarias.biography: Azarias dedicated his life to studying wild creatures around the world. As it turned into obsession, he started to spend most of his time in the wilderness, but as a result, his insight of many beasts’ strengths and weaknesses became unparelleled.
hero.new-pavilion.0_azarias.name: Azarias
hero.new-pavilion.0_azarias.specialty.de: Increases the speed of Wadjets or Venomous Wadjets by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.new-pavilion.0_cassandra.biography: Cassandra’s cold and unyielding character comes to light every time she settles her province’s matters as a high judge. Her incorruptible spirit and harsh punishments yielded her the sympathy of Ammuts, ever fond of feasts that each execution brings.
hero.new-pavilion.0_cassandra.name: Cassandra
Increases the speed of Ammuts or Devouring Ammuts by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.new-pavilion.0_elspeth.biography: Elspeth braved the endless desert uncountable number of times and seems to know all of its secrets by heart. All of her troops always seem invigorated and filled with unknown force, perhaps thanks to the fabled spring of life?
hero.new-pavilion.0_elspeth.name: Elspeth
hero.new-pavilion.0_gideon.biography: Gideon has been born with the favour of gods and this is probably why he has grown so reckless. It was a surprise to many that he didn't grow into a zealous warrior, but he still seems to consider blades and arrows randomly breaking on his chest as a welcome boon.
hero.new-pavilion.0_gideon.name: Gideon
hero.new-pavilion.0_gideon.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.new-pavilion.0_ko-Eset.biography: Ko-Eset of enigmatic Falcon clan never shuns from lucrative opportunities and risky ventures. The jealous often accuse her of dabbling in sorcery but her industrious spirit and foresight are sole reasons for her wealth.
hero.new-pavilion.0_ko-Eset.name: Ko-Eset
hero.new-pavilion.0_ko-Eset.specialty.de: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.new-pavilion.0_marzum.biography: Marzum made his name as a sadistic and influential governor by constantly exploiting his servants. It is said that there is nothing he loves more than a sound of the whip cracking on human skin.
hero.new-pavilion.0_marzum.name: Marzum
hero.new-pavilion.0_marzum.specialty.des: Increases the speed of Whippers or Overseers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills for each level attained after 1st level.
hero.new-pavilion.0_sekhem.biography: As an aspect of the Goddess’ rage, Sekhem is unfit to live with her sisters at the temple. In attempt to quench the undying thirst for blood and gore, she seeks battle during the times of war and unrest.
hero.new-pavilion.0_sekhem.name: Sekhem
hero.new-pavilion.0_sekhem.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.new-pavilion.0_varn.biography: The only thing Varn could remember when he woke up in the middle of the desert, was his name. He wanders seeking answers to the mystery of his past and his purpose.
hero.new-pavilion.0_varn.name: Varn
hero.new-pavilion.0_varn.specialty.descr: Increases the speed of Anubians or Divine Anubians by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.new-pavilion.0_varn.specialty.name: Anubians
hero.new-pavilion.1_amanra.biography: Amanra was the first daughter of a powerful Vizier but laws of the land foiled her ambition to inherit the family’s legacy. She turned to the dark arts to seize her birthright by force.
hero.new-pavilion.1_amanra.name: Amanra
hero.new-pavilion.1_amanra.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to sorcery skill percentage.
hero.new-pavilion.1_bast.biography: As everyone knows, Priestesses do not like to hurry. They do everything carefully and with grace, but Bast is different. On a horseback, she can outrun the fastest riders.
hero.new-pavilion.1_bast.name: Bast
hero.new-pavilion.1_bast.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.new-pavilion.1_bast.specialty.name: Logistics
hero.new-pavilion.1_jaffa.biography: Jaffa was a servant of a cruel overlord and had to torture innocents at his master’s behest. When the opportunity of a coup presented itself, he was first to join the rebels and made a vow to use his powers only for good the moment he had finally plunged a dagger into the tyrant’s chest.
hero.new-pavilion.1_jaffa.name: Jaffa
hero.new-pavilion.1_jaffa.specialty.desc: Casts meteor shower with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.new-pavilion.1_jaffa.specialty.name: Meteor Shower
hero.new-pavilion.1_keila.biography: Young Keila never sought fame or approval, but when a grand magus offered her an apprenticeship, she couldn’t refuse. Rewriting hundreds of parchments and tomes gave her great deal of arcane knowledge and satisfaction.
hero.new-pavilion.1_keila.name: Keila
hero.new-pavilion.1_keila.specialty.desc: Casts Slow with increased effect (10% increase).
hero.new-pavilion.1_keila.specialty.name: Slow
hero.new-pavilion.1_menet.biography: Menet is said to be the first to undergo the metamorphosis. She treats other Priestesses like her daughters, helping and supporting them in service of the Goddess, and they repay her in kind.
hero.new-pavilion.1_menet.name: Menet
hero.new-pavilion.1_menet.specialty.desc: Increases the speed of any Priestesses or High Priestesses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.new-pavilion.1_menet.specialty.name: Priestesses
hero.new-pavilion.1_osir.biography: Osir’s family wealth allowed his healing talents to bloom under the tutelage of most esteemed priests. Sometimes, he ponders his unfulfilled ambition to become a powerful magus, but he takes great pride in his craft and eagerly aids the weak and the ill.
hero.new-pavilion.1_osir.name: Osir
hero.new-pavilion.1_osir.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.new-pavilion.1_osir.specialty.name: First Aid
hero.new-pavilion.1_peth-Shub.biography: Peth-Shub of enigmatic Falcon clan served the royal court for many years. Thanks to his intuition and keen eye, he eliminated numerous threats to the Pharaoh and became one of the most trusted guardians.
hero.new-pavilion.1_peth-Shub.name: Peth-Shub
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Eagle Eye skill percentage.
hero.new-pavilion.1_seref.biography: Seref’s fierce, yet protective nature has been widely known ever since she became an initiate. It surprised no one that she was chosen as one of the Goddess’ aspects – a shield that protects Her faithful.
hero.new-pavilion.1_seref.name: Seref
hero.new-pavilion.1_seref.specialty.desc: All units in Seref's army are enchanted with Advanced Fire Shield at the beginning of battle.
hero.new-pavilion.1_seref.specialty.name: Fire Shield
hero.new-pavilion.1_zamonth.biography: Zamonth could never accept that necromantic arts had been banned by the priest caste. It was only because of his almost divine status that he was allowed to keep dark tomes containing the forbidden knowledge.
hero.new-pavilion.1_zamonth.name: Zamonth
